system.webhook.events.channelModelFetchF: Triggered when fetching a channel's model list keeps failing and reaches the alert threshold.
system.webhook.events.channelModelFetchR: Triggered when a channel's model list can be fetched again after previous failures.
system.webhook.events.channelModelsChang: Triggered when a channel's model list gains or loses models. The payload lists the added and removed model names.
system.retry.loadBalancerStrategy.docume: Applies only to resolved configured models, not channel tests, playground, explicit channel models or legacy fallback. Pins each API key + mapped model to one channel. All upstream errors, regardless of HTTP status, use the configured same-channel retries and delay, then relay within this model and authorized channels; an invalid target also relays. Continues unfinished failure rounds across client requests; 30s exponential cooldown up to 10min. No automatic failback or channel/credential auto-disable. Ignores trace/thread affinity; state is process-local.
system.retry.modelSticky.title: Fixed-channel runtime control
system.retry.modelSticky.description: Each row is one API key + mapped configured model, controlled only by the workspace owner. Candidates reflect the latest authorized request, not a permission grant. A manual switch is temporary and still fails over within this model on real failure or target removal; only its cooldown is cleared. Ordinary edits preserve valid pins and failure records. Strategy changes clear affected state; reset clears this row and container restart clears all runtime state.
system.retry.modelSticky.empty: No runtime states yet. Enable the fixed-channel strategy and send a request first.
system.retry.modelSticky.preferred: Manual target accepted: {{channel}}. A valid response pins it; all upstream errors use configured retry budgets before relay. Cancellation or normal early close does not revoke it; target removal relays within this model.
system.retry.modelSticky.resetHint: Reset clears this key + model pin, failure round and all channel cooldowns. Switching is not a permanent lock.
